messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning to pin cedar-7b-v2 in the model catalog and do a quiet launch tomorrow 09:30 PT. Who can own deploy coordination and smoke?
AJ Chen: I can take deploy coordination. I’ll be on standby 09:15–10:30 PT.
Sergei Petrov: I can run the smoke tests and sanity evals. Will prepare the prompt set and perf checks.
Samira Gomez: I’ll do the rollback readiness checklist and make sure metrics/alerts are wired.
Maya Patel: Awesome. AJ — can you kick off the canary at 09:30 with 5% traffic, then 20% at +10m if stable? devops-bot will post status.
AJ Chen: yep. Plan: 09:30 canary 5% -> wait 10m -> 20% -> wait 20m -> full swap. Manual hold at each step.
Sergei Petrov: Smoke test plan (short): 1) 50 prompts from smoke set, 2) latency P50/P95, 3) top-k sample quality check. I’ll post results here.
Samira Gomez: Rollback criteria: error rate >1% OR P95 > 350ms OR quality regression on >10% of prompts. If triggered, we abort and pin back to cedar-7b-v1.
Maya Patel: config snippet for catalog pinning I uploaded to the repo; copying minimal here for reference:
```
model: cedar-7b-v2
pin: true
canary: 0.05
canary_step_delay: 600  # seconds
rollback_policy:
  latency_threshold_ms: 350
  error_rate_pct: 1.0
  quality_fail_pct: 10
```
AJ Chen: deployed a staging manifest for the canary. devops-bot: scheduled job created -> job_id: j-cedar-20260401-01 (react :white_check_mark:).
devops-bot: deploy job j-cedar-20260401-01 started 1719005400. Canary 5% routing applied.
Sergei Petrov: smoke run started — running 50 prompts now. Will post pass/fail + latencies.
Sergei Petrov: smoke results: 50/50 prompts OK, P50 42ms, P95 290ms, no obvious quality regressions on sampled checks. Posting a short gist with outputs: https://gist.github.com/fake/smoke-cedar-7b-v2
AJ Chen: holding at 5% for 10m, monitoring. Maya — want me to proceed to 20% at +10m?
Maya Patel: yes go for 20% if no alerts. Samira — can you confirm dashboards and rollback playbook link are in the thread?
Samira Gomez: dashboards ✅, rollback playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cedar-pin-rollback. I’ve added a checklist comment in the runbook for who calls the rollback.
AJ Chen: increased to 20% at 09:40 PT. No anomalies so far.
Sergei Petrov: re-ran smoke subset at 20% — 30/30 ok, P95 310ms. Within thresholds.
Maya Patel: OK plan to complete swap at +20m (10:00 PT). AJ will execute, Samira on rollback watch, Sergei final perf pass.
AJ Chen: performing full swap now. devops-bot: swap completed -> new alias cedar: cedar-7b-v2 (job j-cedar-20260401-01 finished). (react :tada:)
devops-bot: audit: pin=cedar-7b-v2, previous=cedar-7b-v1, timestamp=1719001890
Samira Gomez: Post-swap checks running — telemetry flowing, cost baseline within expected range. I’ll keep this open for 1 hour.
Maya Patel: thank you all. If anything unexpected shows up, call rollback and tag @Samira. Otherwise we’ll update the catalog release note and close this thread. :thumbsup:
AJ Chen: noted; I’ll do the release note + PR to the catalog repo.
Sergei Petrov: adding a short eval job to run overnight for more coverage.
Maya Patel: closing summary: owner=AJ (deploy), smoke=Sergei, rollback=Samira, canary=5->20->100, pin applied. Great work everyone.
